description: This file contains utility functions for managing Kubernetes resource lists, including comparison, arithmetic operations, filtering, and usage calculation, specifically for resource quota management.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Checks if two resource lists are equivalent by comparing their keys and values.

methods.name: LessThanOrEqual
methods.description: Determines if resource list a is less than or equal to b for all resources, returning a boolean and list of resource names that exceeded.

methods.name: Max
methods.description: Returns a resource list containing the maximum values for each resource from two lists.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds two resource lists together, summing quantities for matching resources.

methods.name: SubtractWithNonNegativeResult
methods.description: Subtracts resource list b from a, ensuring no negative quantities are returned.

methods.name: Subtract
methods.description: Subtracts resource list b from a, allowing negative quantities.

methods.name: Mask
methods.description: Creates a new resource list containing only specified resource names.

methods.name: ResourceNames
methods.description: Returns a list of all resource names in a resource list.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Checks if a resource name is in a list.

methods.name: ContainsPrefix
methods.description: Checks if a resource name has a prefix contained in a set of prefixes.

methods.name: Intersection
methods.description: Returns the sorted intersection of two resource name lists.

methods.name: Difference
methods.description: Returns the sorted difference of two resource name lists.

methods.name: IsZero
methods.description: Checks if all quantities in a resource list are zero.

methods.name: RemoveZeros
methods.description: Returns a resource list with zero quantities removed.

methods.name: IsNegative
methods.description: Returns resource names with negative quantities.

methods.name: ToSet
methods.description: Converts a list of resource names to a set of strings.

methods.name: CalculateUsage
methods.description: Calculates resource usage for a namespace based on evaluators, handling errors and masking results.
